ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between dominant low-intensity black surface (pixel values <40) and localized high-intensity white anomalies (pixel values >220).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black field across entire visible fluke surface; high-contrast white clusters localized at distal tips; sparse white punctate spots distributed across central and right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression; interior angle estimated at 55 degrees; base of notch vertex is partially occluded by water spray and turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile along the trailing edges of both lobes; high-frequency, high-amplitude topography (10-20 pixels) localized at the distal tips due to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic sweep along the lateral edges; right lobe (viewer perspective) exhibits a more pronounced upward sweep toward the tip than the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) on both distal tips; individual white circular points scattered across the central-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 6-8 parallel linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the upper right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on lateral tips; distinct linear rake marks on the right lobe; multiple small white punctate scars across the ventral surface.
